media-libs/mesa: i965: Fix runaway compute shader optimization Cherry-pick upstream commit 68f69ebd "i965: Use is_scheduling_barrier instead of schedule_node::is_barrier". Reduces runtime of test dEQP-GLES31.functional.ssbo.layout.random.all_shared_buffer.23 from 3.3 minutes to 3.6 seconds. BUG=b:67394445 TEST=1. On DUT, `time deqp-gles31 --deqp-surface-type=fbo \ -n dEQP-GLES31.functional.ssbo.layout.random.all_shared_buffer.23` 2. On DUT, `time deqp-gles31 --deqp-surface-type=fbo \ --deqp-case='dEQP-GLES31.functional.ssbo.*'`. All tests pass. cros-firmware: Pass --legacy to pack_firmware for non-unibuild At present the firmware packer uses the presense of --models to detect that it should create a unibuild firmware update. We want to stop passing this list since it is a pain to create it in the ebuild, and we want the packer to always pack all firmware. As a starting point, pass this flag to pack_firmware when building a non-unbuild firmware update. BUG=chromium:775220 TEST=emerge-reef-uni --nodeps chromeos-firmware-reef emerge-reef --nodeps chromeos-firmware-reef Change-Id: I7d3d4e06a3f3805cd19b0195ff9daa94d3f66659 Signed-off-by: Simon Glass <sjg@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/743181 Reviewed-by: Jason Clinton <jclinton@chromium.org>
